lemoine-1873.author: Émile Lemoine
lemoine-1873.work: Sur quelques propriétés d'un point remarquable du triangle
lemoine-1873.locus: Association Française pour l'Avancement des Sciences (Congrès de Lyon), Comptes Rendus, pp. 90–95
lemoine-1873.note: Foundational memoir introducing the symmedian point K = X(6), the Lemoine line, and the first Lemoine circle.

lemoine-1888.author: Émile Lemoine
lemoine-1888.work: De la mesure de la simplicité dans les sciences mathématiques (Note sur une manière d'évaluer la simplicité des constructions géométriques)
lemoine-1888.locus: AFAS, Compte Rendu de la 17e Session (Congrès d'Oran, 30 mars 1888), Première Partie, p. 161; tirage à part pp. 1–12
lemoine-1888.note: First public announcement of quantitative construction measurement, initially employing an eight-symbol notation (ρ_1..γ'_2) and introducing the set-square (équerre) operations.

lemoine-1892.author: Émile Lemoine
lemoine-1892.work: La Géométrographie ou l'Art des constructions géométriques
lemoine-1892.locus: AFAS, Compte Rendu de la 21e Session (Congrès de Pau, septembre 1892), Seconde Partie, pp. 36–100; tirage à part pp. 1–66
lemoine-1892.publisher: Gauthier-Villars et Fils / Secrétariat de l'AFAS, Paris
lemoine-1892.note: Canonical Pau memoir establishing the five elementary operations R_1, R_2, C_1, C_2, C_3, the coefficients S and E, and Problems I–LXIII.

lemoine-1895.author: Émile Lemoine
lemoine-1895.work: Étude sur le triangle et sur certains points de Géométrographie
lemoine-1895.locus: Proceedings of the Edinburgh Mathematical Society, Vol. 13, pp. 2–25
lemoine-1895.note: Extends Géométrographie to continuous families of triangle configurations and restricted-instrument comparisons.

lemoine-1902.author: Émile Lemoine
lemoine-1902.work: Géométrographie, ou Art des constructions géométriques
lemoine-1902.locus: Collection Scientia, Série Physico-Mathématique, n° 18, 88 pp.
lemoine-1902.note: Definitive monograph synthesizing the Pau ruler-and-compass canon with Géométrographie de l'équerre, Géométrographie Mascheronienne (compass alone), and Géométrographie Steinerienne (straightedge with fixed circle).

mascheroni-1797.author: Lorenzo Mascheroni
mascheroni-1797.note: Classic compass-only treatise proving constructively that every ruler-and-compass point determination can be carried out with the compass alone.

carette-1798.author: Antoine-Michel Carette (trans.)
carette-1798.work: Géométrie du compas, par L. Mascheroni
carette-1798.publisher: Duprat, Libraire pour les Mathématiques, Paris
carette-1798.note: French translation through which Lemoine and French geometers cited Mascheroni's problem numbering and compass-only methods.

fazzari-1901.author: Lorenzo Mascheroni (ed. Gaetano Fazzari)
fazzari-1901.work: La Geometria del Compasso: Nuova edizione con prefazione e note
fazzari-1901.note: Scholarly Italian edition whose preface (p. xi) explicitly compares Mascheroni's constructions with Euclidean methods via 'il metodo della Geometrografia del Lemoine'.

mohr-1672.author: Georg Mohr
mohr-1672.work: Euclides Danicus, Bestaende udi Too Deele
mohr-1672.locus: Parts I–II, 36 pp. (republished with German translation by J. Hjelmslev, Copenhagen: Høst & Søn, 1928)
mohr-1672.note: Earliest complete proof of compass-only Euclidean constructibility, anticipating Mascheroni by 125 years.

poncelet-1822.author: Jean-Victor Poncelet
poncelet-1822.work: Traité des propriétés projectives des figures
poncelet-1822.locus: Tome I, Section III, Chapitre III, §§ 351–358
poncelet-1822.note: First statement of the theorem that a single circle traced with its center suffices for all ruler-and-compass constructions using the straightedge alone.

steiner-1833.author: Jakob Steiner
steiner-1833.work: Die geometrischen Constructionen, ausgeführt mittelst der geraden Linie und Eines festen Kreises, als Lehrgegenstand auf höheren Unterrichts-Anstalten und zur praktischen Benutzung
steiner-1833.locus: §§ 1–22, [1]–[110]; Ostwald's Klassiker der exakten Wissenschaften Nr. 60, ed. A. J. von Oettingen (1895)
steiner-1833.note: Systematic demonstration of straightedge-only constructibility with one fixed circle and its center across eight canonical fundamental problems (§ 18, [68]–[85]).

adler-1890.author: August Adler
adler-1890.work: Zur Theorie der Mascheronischen Constructionen / Theorie der geometrischen Konstruktionen
adler-1890.locus: Sitzungsberichte der Kaiserlichen Akademie der Wissenschaften in Wien, Math.-Naturwiss. Classe, Bd. 99, Abt. IIa, pp. 910–916; Sammlung Göschen Nr. 301
adler-1890.publisher: K.-K. Hof- und Staatsdruckerei, Vienna / G. J. Göschen, Leipzig
adler-1890.note: Unified proof of Mascheroni's theorem via circle inversion (5C_1 + 3C_3) alongside comparative expositions of Steiner's constructions and Lemoine's Géométrographie.

euclid-heath.author: Euclid (trans. Sir Thomas L. Heath)
euclid-heath.work: The Thirteen Books of Euclid's Elements
euclid-heath.locus: 3 vols. (Books I–XIII); GEOMETOR Digital Scriptorium Edition (geometor/euclid & geometor/elements)
euclid-heath.note: Standard English philological reference and axiomatic proposition benchmark for Lemoine's Euclidean comparisons.

pappus-synagoge.author: Pappus of Alexandria
pappus-synagoge.work: Synagoge (Mathematical Collection), Book VII: On the Domain of Analysis
pappus-synagoge.locus: ed. Friedrich Hultsch (1876–1878); ed. & trans. Alexander Jones (Springer, 1986)
pappus-synagoge.note: Source of complete-quadrilateral harmonic division and projective incidence lemmas underlying Lemoine's zero-circle constructions.

proclus-in-euclidem.author: Proclus Diadochus
proclus-in-euclidem.work: In primum Euclidis Elementorum librum commentarii
proclus-in-euclidem.locus: ed. Gottfried Friedlein (1873); trans. Glenn R. Morrow (Princeton University Press, 1970)
proclus-in-euclidem.note: Classical philosophical commentary on postulates, instruments, and the problem/theorem distinction.

hilbert-1899.author: David Hilbert
hilbert-1899.locus: Siebentes Kapitel: Die geometrischen Konstruktionen auf Grund der Axiome I–IV (§§ 36–39)
hilbert-1899.note: Algebraic characterization (pythagorean vs. euclidean quadratic fields) of constructions executable with straightedge and unit-segment transferrer.

hoenen-1954.author: Peter H. J. Hoenen, S.J.
hoenen-1954.work: De Noetica Geometriae: Origine Theoriae Cognitionis
hoenen-1954.note: Epistemological investigation of geometric phantasia, intelligible matter, and constructive intuition.

kimberling-etc.author: Clark Kimberling
kimberling-etc.locus: X(1) Incenter, X(2) Centroid, X(3) Circumcenter, X(6) Symmedian/Lemoine Point, X(7) Gergonne, X(8) Nagel, X(10) Spieker, X(98) Tarry, X(99) Steiner
kimberling-etc.publisher: University of Evansville / GEOMETOR ETC Codex
kimberling-etc.note: Canonical trilinear/barycentric indexing of the triangle centers benchmarked in Lemoine Problems XXI, XXVII, and L–LXIII.

altshiller-court-1952.author: Nathan Altshiller-Court
altshiller-court-1952.work: College Geometry: An Introduction to the Modern Geometry of the Triangle and the Circle
altshiller-court-1952.locus: 2nd ed., Chapters IV–X (Similitude, Harmonic Division, Inversion, Recent Geometry of the Triangle)
altshiller-court-1952.note: Modern synthetic reference connecting antiparallels, symmedians, Brocard geometry, radical axes, and circle inversion.

mackay-1893.author: John Sturgeon Mackay
mackay-1893.locus: Proceedings of the Edinburgh Mathematical Society, Vol. 12, pp. 2–16
mackay-1893.note: First systematic English-language exposition of Lemoine's Pau memoir applied across Euclid's Elements.
